author: Tim (Soupy)
name: Saturation Map
description: A diagnostic HaldCLUT by Tim (Soupy) from the '"objectively" judging saturation' thread on pixls.us: it renders highly saturated colors as white and lowly saturated colors as black, turning the image into a grayscale saturation map. Apply it temporarily in the lut3d module to judge where an edit's saturation actually sits, rather than as a creative look.
